title: RM/sqft source-level implementation
summary: Define and implement RM/sqft from the same canonical calculation data used by Budget and Cost Estimate.
details: BuildPlanner: one Built-up Area + one RM/sqft. RenovationPlanner: Existing Area/Existing RM/sqft and New Area/New RM/sqft must remain separate. Placement: Construction/Renovation Budget, Cost Estimate and Cost Estimate History. Test live before saving latest-working.

title: Development Log
summary: Add a persistent Admin development log for current TerajuWorks product development.
details: Records are stored in GitHub main rather than browser local storage, so the development history survives device and cache changes.
